en.r: Adirondack Park is a park in New York, United States. It has been protected since 1892. Under the IUCN system it is a protected landscape, where nature and traditional human use coexist.
en.h: A vast area of northeastern New York centered on the Adirondack Mountains, established in 1892 for "the free use of all the people" and for watershed protection. At 25,000 km² it is the largest park in the contiguous United States; about 52% is private land and 48% is state-owned Forest Preserve. It has 105 towns and villages and over 12.4 million visitors a year.
en.ff: It holds an estimated 810 km² of old-growth forest, 2,800 lakes and ponds and 48,000 km of rivers and streams.

Protege naufragios históricos y zonas de gran importancia cultural y espiritual para la Confederación Haudenosaunee.

pt.r: O Three Falls State Park é um parque estadual em Nova York, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 36 hectares e está protegido desde 2026.
pt.h: Parque de 90 acres aberto em 2026 na margem do lago Cayuga, Nova York, ao norte de Taughannock Falls, perto de Trumansburg. Em Frog Point houve uma balsa e um povoado no século XIX; de 1928 ao século XXI foi o acampamento escoteiro Camp Barton.

en.r: Three Falls State Park is a state park in New York, United States. It covers 36 hectares and has been protected since 2026.
en.h: A 90-acre park opened in 2026 on Cayuga Lake, New York, north of Taughannock Falls, near Trumansburg. Frog Point had a ferry and a small community in the 19th century; from 1928 into the 21st century it was the Camp Barton scout camp.
en.ff: Trumansburg Creek forms three waterfalls, including 128-foot Frontenac Falls.
at: Frontenac Falls and two more waterfalls
Half a mile of Cayuga Lake shore
